title: make repin leaves the viewer's ui pin where it is
foundBy: user report (host): "is make repin also repinning the npm dependency on the ui npm package in the ledger, tracer and campaign projects?"

evidence.verified: In a clean clone of main with the change, `make repin` moved the viewer's ui pin to ui's last build. It set `UIVersion`, took `RendererVersion` to 0.7.1 and rendered both ledgers again, and `make ci` then passed. A second run changed nothing, and `make -n repin` moved no pin. TestUIVersionIsTheViewersPin fails on a pin moved by hand. ci runs 35957442694 and 35958974101 passed on the two commits.

resolution: `make repin` moves the viewer's `@codesweep-ai/ui` pin to the npm version of ui's last build, through `scripts/repin-npm.mjs`, and rebuilds the committed viewer on it. Where the status file lists no npm version yet, it takes the version the build's npm image carries. A pin whose project lists no build stays where it is. In this repository `make viewer-repin` then sets `UIVersion`, moves `RendererVersion` up a patch, and renders both pages again, and a test holds `UIVersion` to the pin.
details: `make repin` moves the codesweep-ai tools in `go.mod` to the last commit each one's CI built, and stops there. The viewer's `@codesweep-ai/ui` pin in `viewer/package.json` stays where it was set by hand. It moves only through oss-repin, which needs every sibling checked out beside this one. A clone of this repository alone has no way to take ui's last build. Moving it by hand takes more than the pin here. The viewer's bytes are part of every page cs-ledger renders, so `UIVersion` and `RendererVersion` have to move with it, and both pages this repository carries need rendering again. Nothing checks that `UIVersion` names the pin.
